account.description: The account it puts in force: a Singapore bank's, in SGD.

approval_id.description: The approval request it waits for.

checks.description: A draft or waiting change: what stops it being asked for or approved (✖), and its warnings (⚠). Empty in a list.

in_force.description: Its account is the person's account for reimbursements now.

member_user_id.description: The person whose account it is.

prepared_by.description: Who saved its current version: an actor of the audit trail.

replaces.description: A draft or waiting change: the account in force it would replace, if any.

status.description: draft: being prepared; waiting: asked for, waiting for approval, and payments to the person are frozen; approved: in force, or replaced since (in_force says).

version.description: The change's version; with its status it makes the ETag.
